scenarios.description: Switch from FIFO to priority-based queueing so urgent samples pre-empt the queue at every resource.
Add one extra unit to each analyzer (biochemistry, hematology, immunology) to relieve analysis-stage saturation.
Automate registration (e.g. barcode intake) to roughly halve its processing time.
Reassign one registration staff member to centrifugation, which the baseline analysis identifies as more saturated.
Replace fixed-interval centrifugation batching with adaptive batching (batch fires on full capacity, oldest-sample wait threshold, or an urgent sample).
Stress test: increase mean arrival rate by 30% with the baseline resource configuration unchanged.
Stress test: the biochemistry analyzer loses one of its two units for a 90-minute outage starting at t=200 minutes.
Combine the sustained improvement scenarios (S1, S2, S3, S4, S5) into a single configuration; demand/failure stress scenarios (S6, S7) are intentionally excluded.
